acceptance: The six historical dimension tables load on DuckDB and pass their official audit tests at scales 3 and 5.
Alerts and the Prospect status message are written inside the transformations.
Every kept or changed behaviour of the project is catalogued with its clause.
context: Step of the TPC-DI plan based on shannon-barrow/databricks-tpc-di. The full plan (inventory of the project, the 34 departures from the specification with file and line, target architecture, step list) is the description of tpcdi-plan-databricks-base-20261121; every owner decision is quoted on tpcdi-correction-plan-20261120. description:
## Problem
The dimension tables of the historical load (Clause 4.5) do not exist in BenchBox. The Databricks project has them but writes all alerts once after Batch 3 with the current time, writes no Prospect status message, hard-codes status names, and uses floating point.

## Owner decisions (choice dialogs, 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-21)
- 2026-11-21: "Make a new plan to base our TPC-DI implementation on it [shannon-barrow/databricks-tpc-di]. We will be using the DuckDB implementation for comparison. We MUST adhere as closely as possible to the spec/paper. We will be generalize and 'benchbox-ifying' the source to make it well integrated with BenchBox and consistent across platforms."
- 2026-11-21: where the project and the specification differ, "The specification wins without asking. Every difference, and any behaviour of the project that is kept, goes in a catalogue I approve at the milestone stop. A difference from the DuckDB implementation not in the catalogue is a finding that blocks the step."
- 2026-11-21, DIGen answer-key errors: "Correct only those attributes when loading the audit table, from an independent recount that shares no code with the ETL; list each correction in the result; never edit generated files."

## Change
Add `etl/historical/` SQL for DimCompany, DimSecurity, Financial, DimCustomer, DimAccount and Prospect, in the order of Clause 4.3.3, derived from the project's `silver/{DimCompany,DimSecurity,Financial,DimCustomer Historical,DimAccount Historical,Prospect}.sql` and `bronze/ingest_prospectincremental.sql` (Batch 1 part), with these changes to follow the specification (plan section 3, rows 10, 11, 17, 21, 25 to 27): alerts for invalid SPRating, invalid customer tier and date of birth are written by the transformation itself with the phase's BatchID; Prospect writes its 'Inserted rows' status message; status and type names come from joins to StatusType and TradeType, not literals; exact numerics; flags per step 7's rule. Kept from the project: the surrogate-key formula (date and natural key), the daily grain for customer history. Each kept or changed behaviour is a row in `DEPARTURES.yaml` with its clause. Review each table clause by clause and add rows for anything the plan did not list (effective dating of DimCompany and DimSecurity, phone formatting, marketing nameplate edge cases).

## Decision gates
Where the specification's text is unclear and the project's behaviour is one possible reading, follow the specification's most literal reading and record the alternative in `DEPARTURES.yaml` for the owner's approval at the milestone stop; do not stop for each one. Stop only if a table cannot pass its audit tests under any reading.

## Verification rubric
Pass, at scales 3 and 5 on DIGen data through `make heavy-run`: every official audit test that reads only these tables and DImessages returns OK (the list of such tests is in the pull request, each run from the unmodified Appendix A text through step 8's loader); alert counts in DImessages equal DIGen's audit values after step 11's corrections; a test fails if a status name literal appears in `etl/historical/*.sql`; `DEPARTURES.yaml` validates against its schema and a test reads it; comparison with the DuckDB implementation on these tables shows no unlisted difference; `make pr-preflight` passes. Status of any result remains not validated; the CLI still refuses.

## Guardrails (owner, 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-21)
- The agent never posts a stand-in review, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`.
- Arming: `make pr-arm` once; one more attempt only when the refusal named a cause, the agent reported it and the cause is cleared; never a third without asking. `make pr-rerun` at most once and only for a job the runner never ran or cancelled, never for a failed test.
- Review threads: reply; resolve only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise the finding again.
- Subagents are read-only. No file edit by script; use the edit tool. Do not edit a pull request description while its CI is starting; post a comment.
- Any limit, default, threshold, status token, message or label text the owner has not already chosen (see tpcdi-correction-plan-20261120) is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- A blocked step stops this item; no workaround. No live cloud run. Heavy work only through `make heavy-run`. One pull request for this item, merged before the next item starts.
- From the quarantine step until the reopening step, no TPC-DI entry point may produce a result that reads PASSED or is admitted for publication.
- Sources. SQL derived from the Databricks project (`src/incremental_batches/**` at commit 8e0f944, treated as MIT on the owner's instruction) may be committed only after the provenance step has merged, only under `benchbox/core/tpcdi/etl/`, with every file listed in `PROVENANCE.json` and with all comments removed.
- TPC and bankmark files (DIGen, PDGF, dictionaries, configuration, EULA, appendix SQL) come only from the official archive the owner supplies, are committed unmodified and only in the directories named in the tools step. Never copy from the Databricks project or the DuckDB implementation: their copies of the tools or the tools zip, DIGen output, generated reference files, audit snapshots, their copy or rewrite of the appendix SQL, or any generator code (`src/tools/**`). Never commit DIGen output.
- The specification wins over the Databricks project without asking. Each behaviour of the project that is kept and each change made to follow the specification is one row in `benchbox/core/tpcdi/etl/DEPARTURES.yaml`, which the owner approves at the milestone stop.
- A difference from the DuckDB implementation (djouallah/tpcdi) that is not in the written list of expected differences is a finding: it is triaged and listed in the pull request before the step is armed.
- Staging files produced by DIGen are never edited. The official audit, validation and visibility SQL is never edited in the repository.
